---
title: "Кладбища"
listing:
  - id: grid-view
    contents: "../cemeteries/"
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 4
    fields: [image, title, subtitle, status, area, tomb-dating, tomb-amount, catalog]
    sort-ui: [title, status, area, tomb-dating, tomb-amount]
    filter-ui: [title, subtitle, status]    
    field-display-names:
      tomb-dating: "Датировка"
      status: "Статус"
      area: "Площадь"
      tomb-amount: "Памятников"
      catalog: "Каталог"
  - id: table-view
    contents: "../cemeteries/"
    type: table
    table-striped: true
    table-hover: false
    fields: [code, title, country, status, tomb-dating, tomb-amount, catalog]
    sort-ui: [code, title, country, status, tomb-dating, tomb-amount]
    filter-ui: [code, title, country, status]    
    field-links: [title]
    field-display-names:
      code: "Код"
      title: "Место"
      country: "Cтрана"
      tomb-dating: "Датировка"
      status: "Статус"
      tomb-amount: "Памятников"
      catalog: "Каталог"
include-in-header:
  - text: |
      <style>
          .reduced-intervals p {
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
          }

         .quarto-grid-item .card-title {
            font-weight: bold;
          }

         .quarto-grid-item .card-other-values tr>td:first-of-type {
            padding-left: 0px;
            vertical-align: middle;
          }
       
      </style>
---
